record.title: Jordan Iraq Trebil conflict closure
record.imposing_authority: Iraqi authorities imposed the July 2015 closure; Jordanian and Iraqi officials jointly marked formal reopening.
record.enforcement: Formal ceremony observed; AP reported Iraqi processing was initially unready. Normal traffic restart date remains unverified.
record.status_observation: Historical evidence only; no current-status inference
record.official_rationale: AP attributes the Iraqi closure to denying Islamic State revenue from levies on cargo trucks; highway security was cited in the reopening context.
record.context: Reopening followed Iraqi recovery of highway and customs/security arrangements.
record.uncertainty: July 2015 Iraqi closure to deprive ISIS of truck-tax income is now month-dated. 30 August 2017 was a formal ceremony; AP field report explicitly says normal truck/passenger resumption date was not fixed, and processing remained unready. Do not convert the ceremony into an actual operational endpoint.

historical.duration_note: Formal change of permission; operational reopening and continuous effective duration not established. Month-precision onset and formal endpoint: no exact actual closed-day count.

claim_checks.Historical note — current findings are i: AP field reporting describes the Trebil closure and ceremony.
AP explicitly dates Iraqi authorities' closure to July 2015. Limits retained: July 2015 month supported; no exact day.
30 August 2017 is the ceremony; AP says no firm normal truck/passenger resumption date was set and processing was initially unavailable.

Hierarchical coding: see Rationale coding for subcategories, attribution and phases. The recorded rationale and claim assessment support the selected subcategories. All applicable broad categories are retained together; no primary rationale is imposed. Prior evidence assessment (before this recoding): Closure aimed to deprive Islamic State of truck-tax income.
The Jordan–Iraq Karameh/Trebil crossing is identified; restoration is not all-category operational proof. Limits retained: Trade/passengers, with practical processing not yet established.
The two-year retrospective description does not prove every day and category; no calculated interval retained.

followup_reviews.Research finding: Formal reopening at Trebil does not resolve ordinary service restoration; retain the scoped last confirmation.
followup_reviews.Challenge finding: 23 October targeted source reconciliation by the primary AI reviewer; no separate challenge or human verification in this pass.

followup_reviews.Separate challenger: GPT-6 Astra Pro /root/rounds_protocol, separate same-model context
followup_reviews.Research finding: Fresh AP field text preserves the distinction between the 30 August ceremony and unready ordinary processing. The 3 September reopening was a plan; the 7 September truck-owner comments still describe future exchanges conditional on preparations. IRU’s general reopening statement provides no observed processing. No defensible ordinary truck/passenger endpoint was found in the bounded search.
followup_reviews.Challenge verdict: Accepted within the root decision; see frozen challenge
followup_reviews.Challenge finding: Challenge packet SHA-256: 3492fa8d8a82b0ab0e816d8cf545b03d29b2525c53e6a0992bb4b623aa0fa9e5. Per-question challenge findings remain in that packet.
followup_reviews.Root decision: Accept seven new parents, eight phases on those parents and one additional May2024 phase on ME026, plus both targeted unresolved Trebil questions. Apply all65 guarded challenger refinements: urgent exceptions in April2018; August2018 reopening established only by August12, with earliest bound unknown; December2023 commercial-only scope with ordinary passengers unaffected. Retain partial and directional Rafah/plant-fuel scopes, operational versus announced May2024 returns, all unknowns and conflicts, fifteen unresolved issues and nine unlocated phases. No numerical duration is invented from a reported day count or general reopening announcement.
followup_reviews.Issue dispositions: REC50-R13-Q02 — First ordinary freight transloading, through-truck movement and passenger processing remain separately unresolved. The present last-confirmed date is retained; September readiness is not converted into a later all-traffic closure confirmation.

followup_reviews.Researcher: GPT-6 Astra Pro /root/resume_r35, original R38 source research
followup_reviews.Separate challenger: GPT-6 Astra Pro /root, separate same-model context
followup_reviews.Research finding: AP directly distinguishes the ceremony from unready ordinary processing. The October 4 ministerial aggregate of 250 cargo trucks establishes later freight activity but supplies neither first truck date nor passenger restart, and does not resolve direct-through versus transshipment conditions. Retain the existing last-confirmed phase and record the later cargo observation as additional evidence.
followup_reviews.Challenge verdict: Accepted within the root decision; see frozen challenge
